title: Blur-It
description: A privacy-focused Chrome extension that detects and blurs sensitive content—including API keys, passwords, emails and payment details—before a screen share or recording. Protected content can be revealed temporarily on hover.
features: Automatically identify and blur common credential and personal-information patterns
Keep sensitive text obscured during live demos and recorded walkthroughs
Reveal blurred content temporarily when needed
workflow: Examine page content locally for sensitive patterns
Apply blur styling to matching elements
Temporarily reveal obscured elements on hover
